quests.name: Edavattam Market (Unniyarcha)
quests.desc: 'Pennaaya njanum virakkunnilla, aanaya ningal virakkunenthe?' Defeat 1 bandit face-to-face. A back-stab pays marma XP but shames the escort — no quest bonus.
quests.fail: marma kill breaks honour; escort re-offers free, no XP lost
